chunks: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
Piercing the ear of the boy is from the Sunnah, and circumcision of the boy is from the Sunnah.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on piercing a boy's ears and circumcision in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi explicitly categorizes both ear piercing and circumcision of young boys as 'Sunnah,' affirming their status as recommended acts within Shia jurisprudence. It highlights the continuity of prophetic traditions in personal hygiene and physical development, linking bodily purification with spiritual discipline. The ruling underscores the importance of early ritual preparation for males in the Shia tradition, emphasizing cleanliness as a component of faith.

en.hubeali:
And from him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Piercing the ear of the boy is from the Sunnah, and circumcision of the boy is from the Sunnah’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Piercing the ears of a boy is of the Sunnah as well as his circumcision.’”
